free_tier.stated: 250 MB free storage per name, 4.5 MB max per file, unlimited uploads/day. No account needed — the 'username' in the URL is claimed on first POST.

egress.terms: free direct GET from uldl.sh; no metering stated.

tooling: curl -X POST https://uldl.sh/<name> -d @- ; MCP connector offered for agents. Versioning of files is supported.
chaining: unlimited distinct namespaces x 250 MB each — the namespace is free and unauthenticated, so it multiplies like a bucket-per-name. 500 GB would need 2,000 namespaces and 111,000 files at the 4.5 MB cap.
limits_note: 4.5 MB per file; 250 MB per name; unlimited uploads/day.
